# gitmoap_group_imported_identities_suggestions (Data Source)

Suggest links for outside authors. The outside authors who are very likely members of this organization: their commits were made with the address a member signs in with. A suggestion links nobody; propose it, and the person accepts. Needs a Maintainer of the organization.

The token needs `import:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_imported_identities_suggestions" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The organization's top-level group

- `group_imported_identities_suggestions` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_imported_identities_suggestions))

### Nested Schema for `group_imported_identities_suggestions`

Read-Only:

- `identity_id` (String) Identifies an outside author: one account on the service a repository was imported from.
- `user_id` (String)
- `username` (String) Their username.
